    <title>3.15.0-rc.0 / 2026-09-09</title>
    <content type="html"><ul>
<li>[CHANGE] PromQL: A range query whose <code>end</code> was not aligned to <code>step</code> caused subqueries inside it to evaluate past the parent's last actual step, inflating <code>peakSamples</code> in the query stats and against the <code>query.max-samples</code> limit, and wasting storage I/O reading samples that were never used in the result. Add tests to prevent regression of the fix made in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3938028026" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/18081" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18081/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18081">#18081</a>. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4345389244" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/18598" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18598/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18598">#18598</a></li>
<li>[CHANGE] PromQL: Do not register a start timestamp reset if the start timestamp hasn't changed between subsequent samples. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5192551313" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19454" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19454/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19454">#19454</a></li>
<li>[CHANGE] Logging: Deprecate <code>--log.level</code>; use <code>runtime.log_level</code> configuration to supply the default level. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5224041583" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19511" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19511/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19511">#19511</a></li>
<li>[FEATURE] Configuration: Allow changing the process log level through <code>runtime.log_level</code> on configuration reload. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5224041583" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19511" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19511/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19511">#19511</a></li>
<li>[FEATURE] Prometheus: Add <code>--auto-gomemlimit.refresh-interval</code> flag to periodically re-detect the container or system memory limit and update <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> at runtime. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4576939028" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/18843" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18843/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18843">#18843</a></li>
<li>[FEATURE] Scraping: Add support for scraping targets via Unix Domain Sockets. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="1600464759" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/12024" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/issues/12024/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/12024">#12024</a>. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3944049340" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/18091" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18091/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18091">#18091</a></li>
<li>[FEATURE] scrape: Implement OM2.0 scrape format. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4349571932" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/18606" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18606/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18606">#18606</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] Reduce TSDB head CPU utilization when initializing. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3891670867" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/18001" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18001/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18001">#18001</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] Docker SD: Add labels <code>__meta_docker_container_image</code> and <code>__meta_docker_container_image_id</code>. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5110343430" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19386" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19386/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19386">#19386</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] Mixin: Add a p95/p99 remote-write send-batch latency panel to the remote-write dashboard. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5217341706" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19500" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19500/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19500">#19500</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] Mixin: Support native histograms in the remote-write send-batch latency panel. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5245595953" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19522" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19522/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19522">#19522</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] PromQL/TSDB: The <code>--enable-feature=st-storage</code> flag now automatically enables XOR2 float chunk encoding and ST-capable histogram chunk encoding, so you no longer need to pass <code>xor2-encoding</code> and <code>histograms-st-encoding</code> alongside it. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5237371637" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19518" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19518/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19518">#19518</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] Remote write / Alertmanager: upgrade sigv4 to v0.5.0, adding <code>session_name</code> and <code>tags</code> fields for STS AssumeRole sessions. The previously undocumented <code>service_name</code> field is now also documented. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5320987314" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19569" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19569/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19569">#19569</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] Scraping: Support zstd-compressed scrape responses, enabled via feature flag <code>zstd-scrape</code>. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5220861330" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19502" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19502/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19502">#19502</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] TSDB: Stabilize the XOR2 float chunk encoding. <code>--enable-feature=xor2-encoding</code> is deprecated; use <code>storage.tsdb.chunk_encoding.floats: xor2</code> instead. Check that other software reading the TSDB directly (e.g. Thanos sidecar) supports XOR2 before enabling. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5194965757" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19461" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19461/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19461">#19461</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] TSDB: add <code>prometheus_tsdb_head_appenders_created_total</code> metric. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5141659323" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19411" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19411/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19411">#19411</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] Tracing: add more spans to scrapes, API queries and rule evaluations. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5140900705" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19410" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19410/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19410">#19410</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] UI: Show the effective configuration for each scrape pool on the Targets and Service Discovery pages. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5109213905" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19384" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19384/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19384">#19384</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] scrape: Enable start time synthesis for summary <code>_count</code> and <code>_sum</code> series in scrape appender v2. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5050083528" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19323" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19323/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19323">#19323</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] scrape: stop all pools in parallel for faster shutdowns. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5008562313" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19295" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19295/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19295">#19295</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] storage/remote: Add undocumented failed_request_logging config field to debug log remote write V2 requests on send errors. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4938911155" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19249" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19249/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19249">#19249</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] TSDB: Add fast path for XOR chunk decompression to speed up queries. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3917571735" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/18049" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18049/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18049">#18049</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] UI: Improve native histogram table formatting and add a background bar indicating the bucket count. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5062660594" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19332" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19332/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19332">#19332</a></li>
<li>[ENHANCEMENT] TSDB: Add <code>prometheus_tsdb_head_series_pending_commit_underflow_total</code> to report pending-sample reservation underflows. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5201464605" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19470" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19470/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19470">#19470</a></li>
<li>[PERF] AWS SD: Build RDS cluster labels once per cluster instead of once per instance. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5223302754" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19504" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19504/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19504">#19504</a></li>
<li>[PERF] AWS SD: Describe RDS instances of different clusters concurrently, bounded by <code>request_concurrency</code>. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5223650959" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19506" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19506/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19506">#19506</a></li>
<li>[PERF] AWS SD: Describe each ElastiCache resource once per refresh instead of twice. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5351876985" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19585" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19585/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19585">#19585</a></li>
<li>[PERF] Remote read: Avoid cloning labels for sampled reads when no external labels are configured. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5222288160" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19503" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19503/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19503">#19503</a></li>
<li>[PERF] Remote write: Reuse OTLP converter scratch state between requests. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5111518138" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19388" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19388/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19388">#19388</a></li>
<li>[PERF] scrape: conversion from classic to native histograms should only parse start times when enabled. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5182864382" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19446" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19446/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19446">#19446</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix <code>info()</code> enrichment for composite expressions with mixed <code>@</code>/offset references or selector-free vector branches, preventing metadata from being evaluated at an unrelated timestamp. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5110557158" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19387" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19387/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19387">#19387</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix info() enrichment when input series use different subsets of identifying labels. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5285757364" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19557" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19557/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19557">#19557</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve metric-name dropping through the info function when delayed name removal is enabled. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5142239534" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19413" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19413/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19413">#19413</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] TSDB: Don't silently drop samples when head garbage collection removes a series while it is being appended to. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4977574601" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19272" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19272/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19272">#19272</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] TSDB: Keep series with uncommitted samples during selected- and stale-series compaction, including when appenders overlap. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5201464605" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19470" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19470/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19470">#19470</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] TSDB: Do not retain head series after a synthetic start-timestamp zero sample is rejected. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5201464605" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19470" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19470/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19470">#19470</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] TSDB: Prevent query panics during series eviction after WAL replay. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5390613471" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19664" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19664/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19664">#19664</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] TSDB: fix potential deadlock between mmapSeriesChunks and gcSeries. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5194491899" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19460" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19460/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19460">#19460</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] TSDB: fix default block reload interval for custom options. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5096909680" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19368" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19368/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19368">#19368</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] AWS SD: Do not crash on serverless MSK clusters or MSK clusters without Open Monitoring. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4887301115" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19194" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19194/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19194">#19194</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] AWS SD: Do not panic when the ElastiCache API omits optional fields of a serverless cache or cache cluster. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5164256949" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19435" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19435/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19435">#19435</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] AWS SD: Reject non-positive <code>request_concurrency</code> instead of hanging service discovery indefinitely. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5249802472" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19524" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19524/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19524">#19524</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] Discovery/AWS: Avoid a panic when discovering standalone ECS tasks with custom task groups. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5024736926" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19302" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19302/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19302">#19302</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] Discovery: Do not panic in AWS Lightsail service discovery when an instance is missing optional fields such as availability zone, blueprint, bundle, name, state or support code. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5051873589" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19324" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19324/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19324">#19324</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] Discovery: delete the stale <code>prometheus_sd_last_update_timestamp_seconds</code> series for a config that is removed on reload. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4837106975" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19131" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19131/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19131">#19131</a></li>
<li>[BUGFIX] HTTP: Avoid truncating compressed responses when handlers set Content-Length. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5388046981" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19661" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19661/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19661">#19661</a></li>

    <title>3.13.3 / 2026-09-07</title>
    <content type="html"><ul>
<li>[SECURITY] Bump github.com/klauspost/compress to v1.18.7 (GO-2026-5841) and golang.org/x/crypto to v0.55.0 (GO-2026-6303).</li>

<li>[BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix case-insensitive regex label matchers silently dropping matching values. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4866544983" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19167" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19167/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19167">#19167</a></li>

<li>[BUGFIX] Alerting: Fix 100% CPU usage on shutdown that could delay graceful shutdown and trigger timeout-based kills. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3812698655" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/17859" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/17859/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/17859">#17859</a></li>

    <title>3.14.0 / 2026-08-17</title>
    <content type="html"><ul>
<li>[CHANGE] API: Deprecate the <code>stats</code> query parameter of <code>/api/v1/query</code> and <code>/api/v1/query_range</code> for values other than <code>true</code> and <code>all</code>. Other values still enable basic statistics but now return a deprecation warning; they will be rejected in the next major release. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4827695511" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/19124" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19124/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/19124">#19124</a></li>
<li>[CHANGE] API: <code>/api/v1/status/config</code> now correctly shows <code>separator: ""</code> and <code>replacement: ""</code> in relabel configs when explicitly set to empty, instead of omitting them. <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4411840486" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/18653" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18653/hovercard" href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/18653">#18653</a></li>

<li>[CHANGE] PromQL: Enable duration expressions by default.
